tests: Understanding why a message is reprocessed by another consumer and how to prevent it.
expected: Increase the queue's visibility timeout and/or call ChangeMessageVisibility to extend it during long processing. Triggers: "takes longer", "picked up by a second consumer before the first finishes".
why_not: Short polling only changes how messages are fetched, not visibility; the retention period defines how long unprocessed messages live and is unrelated to duplicates.
